XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='IHC.ITF.DStruc.Schema.CORPPRVProviderRequest.CORPPRVPROVIDER' targetClass='Request.CleanseProviderDataRequest' create='new' language='objectscript' > <trace value='"In DTL to map to MDM: "' /> <assign value='0' property='phNum' action='set' /> <assign value=' source.PROVIDERDEMOGRAPHIC.ADVPROVIDERFIRSTNM.content ' property='target.ID.NAME.(1).FIRSTNAME' action='set' /> <assign value=' source.PROVIDERDEMOGRAPHIC.ADVPROVIDERMIDDLENM.content' property='target.ID.NAME.(1).MIDDLENAME' action='set' /> <assign value='context.inpData.title' property='target.ID.NAME.(1).TITLE' action='set' /> <assign value='context.inpData.suffix' property='target.ID.NAME.(1).SUFFIX' action='set' /> <assign value=' source.PROVIDERDEMOGRAPHIC.ADVPROVIDERLASTNM.content' property='target.ID.NAME.(1).LASTNAME' action='set' /> <assign value=' "CORPPRV" ' property='target.ID.NAME.(1).COMMENT' action='set' /> <foreach property='source.ADDRESSINFO()' key='k2' > <trace value='"Map ADDRESS and Phone: " _ k2' /> <assign value=' $ZSTRIP(source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRADDRLINE1TXT.content, "<>WC") ' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).ADDRESSLINE1' action='set' /> <if condition='$L($ZSTRIP(source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRADDRLINE2TXT.content, "<>WC")) > 0' > <true> <assign value=' source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRADDRLINE2TXT.content ' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).ADDRESSLINE2' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value=' source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRSTATECD.content ' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).CITY' action='set' /> <assign value=' source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRSTATECD.content ' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).STATE' action='set' /> <assign value=' source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRCOUNTYID.content ' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).COUNTY' action='set' /> <if condition='$L($ZSTRIP(source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRCOUNTRY.content, "<>WC")) > 0' > <true> <assign value=' source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRCOUNTRY.content ' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).COUNTRY' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value=' "USA" ' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).COUNTRY' action='set' /> </false> </if> <assign value=' source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRPOSTALCODE.content ' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).ZIPCODE' action='set' /> <if condition='source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRPRMRYFLG.content = "Y"' > <true> <assign value='"Active:Y"' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).COMMENT' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='"Active:N"' property='target.ID.ADDRESS.(k2).COMMENT' action='set' /> </false> </if> <assign value='phNum + 1' property='phNum' action='set' /> <assign value=' source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRPHONENO.content ' property='target.ID.PHONE.(phNum).PHONENUMBER' action='set' /> <assign value=' "PHONE " _ source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRPRMRYFLG.content ' property='target.ID.PHONE.(phNum).COMMENT' action='set' /> <assign value='phNum + 1' property='phNum' action='set' /> <assign value=' source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRFAXNO.content ' property='target.ID.PHONE.(phNum).PHONENUMBER' action='set' /> <assign value=' "FAX "_ source.ADDRESSINFO.(k2).ADVPRVDRADDRPRMRYFLG.content ' property='target.ID.PHONE.(phNum).COMMENT' action='set' /> </foreach> <trace value='"DTL complete for cleanse service " ' /> </transform>
